task: Network Intrusion Detection on NF-UNSW-NB15-v2 (NetFlow features, edge-level, dynamic graph)
named_components: Statistical disentanglement (per-feature reweighting; SMT-style optimization, approximated by smooth surrogate of Eq. 5)
Representational disentanglement (orthogonality / decorrelation regularizer on element-wise edge embedding components)
Multi-layer (multi-scale) graph diffusion / TGN-style temporal memory with time encoding for dynamic spatiotemporal aggregation
Multi-scale representation fusion for few-shot learning
evaluation_protocols: Binary classification (benign vs attack) with F1 and AUC
Multi-class classification per attack type (per-class F1)
Unknown attack scenario: leave-one-attack-out (LOAO); evaluate F1 on the held-out attack class
Few-shot: k in {1, 5, 10} samples per minority class
baselines: Ablations: w/o statistical disentanglement, w/o representational disentanglement, w/o multi-scale
constraints: Must preserve attack-type granularity in at least one artifact
Reported numbers must be traceable to JSON in outputs/
Use mean ± std over >=3 seeds for headline tables
